verses.text: Then Job answered,
“No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
lines: “No doubt, but you are the people,
and wisdom will die with you.

verses.text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
lines: But I have understanding as well as you;
I am not inferior to you.
Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

verses.text: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
lines: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor,
I, who called on God, and he answered.
The just, the blameless man is a joke.

verses.text: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
lines: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune.
It is ready for them whose foot slips.

verses.text: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
lines: The tents of robbers prosper.
Those who provoke God are secure,
who carry their god in their hands.

verses.text: “But ask the animals, now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
lines: “But ask the animals, now, and they will teach you;
the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

verses.text: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
lines: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you.
The fish of the sea will declare to you.

verses.text: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,
lines: Who doesn’t know that in all these,
Yahweh’s hand has done this,

verses.text: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
lines: in whose hand is the life of every living thing,
and the breath of all mankind?

verses.text: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
lines: Doesn’t the ear try words,
even as the palate tastes its food?

verses.text: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
lines: With aged men is wisdom,
in length of days understanding.

verses.text: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
lines: “With God is wisdom and might.
He has counsel and understanding.

verses.text: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
lines: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again.
He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

verses.text: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
lines: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up.
Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.text: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
lines: With him is strength and wisdom.
The deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.text: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
lines: He leads counselors away stripped.
He makes judges fools.

verses.text: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
lines: He loosens the bond of kings.
He binds their waist with a belt.

verses.text: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
lines: He leads priests away stripped,
and overthrows the mighty.

verses.text: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
lines: He removes the speech of those who are trusted,
and takes away the understanding of the elders.

verses.text: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
lines: He pours contempt on princes,
and loosens the belt of the strong.

verses.text: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
lines: He uncovers deep things out of darkness,
and brings out to light the shadow of death.

verses.text: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
lines: He increases the nations, and he destroys them.
He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

verses.text: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
lines: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth,
and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.text: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
lines: They grope in the dark without light.
He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
